answers.question: Chronological observed prefixes
answers.evidence: Timestamped supplementary records can be ordered, but label-selected records omit benign context; complete official prefixes cannot yet be built.

answers.question: Events after a prediction cutoff
answers.evidence: Supplementary events span several days and include later records; completeness and official-raw coverage are unverified.

answers.question: Independent actual future attack behavior
answers.evidence: Official narrative and third-party annotations exist independently of the predictor; raw alignment and action outcomes require review.

answers.question: ATT&CK mapping independent of predictor output
answers.evidence: Narrative behavior supports later analyst mapping, but no explicit technique IDs were found in the PDF or tasks and no reviewed mapping is ready.

answers.question: Train/validation/test scenario separation
answers.evidence: A complete pilot is unavailable; three related campaign days do not establish sufficient independent scenarios. Host/day groups are not independent incidents.

answers.question: Top-1/3/5, MRR, Macro-F1, Brier, ECE
answers.evidence: No aligned independent technique targets, declared label space, real-data predictions or held-out split.

answers.question: Measure uncertainty
answers.evidence: No real-data predictive distribution or independent uncertainty validation has been produced.

answers.question: Measure calibration
answers.evidence: No untouched calibration/test partitions and aligned probability predictions exist for real telemetry.

answers.question: Real-data holdout evaluation
answers.evidence: Acquisition is partial and no leakage-controlled real holdout has been established.
